suggested_fix: No fix required. The loop checks dai_link[i].num_codecs before dereferencing codecs->name, which avoids a NULL dereference on links that have no codec. The loop is bounded by ARRAY_SIZE of the DAI array that both card variants share. The devm allocation failure is handled. platform_data is set by the ACPI machine-matching code that creates this device. As extra hardening, the code could check mach for NULL and bound the loop by card->num_links.
